tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'dod gsol smon lam dgongs 'dus rta nag gi pad+ma dbang chen 'don pa bsgyur pa ni/1$0000300 lha yi lha mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dus rnams rtag tu khro rgyal khyod sgrub ste: srog gi phyir yang yi dam mi spong na: ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol: khro rgyal 'khor bcas khyod kyi gzi byin gyis: bar chad dgra bgegs tshogs rnams bsal nas kyang: byams pa'i zhal bzang dngos su bstan pa dang: bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir bstsal du gsol:

yang 'bri gung gnam lcags me 'bar gyis mdzad pa'i/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas// lha mchog khyod dang smon lam lhan cig btab// da lta zhal mthong yi dam lhar gsol na// snying po byang chub mchog la mi gnas tshe// tshe rabs 'khor ba gar skye gar gnas kyang*// rjes su zungs shig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// dngos grub stsol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// bar chad sol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// dgra bgegs sgrol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// kun mkhyen zil gnon drag rtsal gyis mdzad pa'i/ mkhyen brtse nus mnga' 'jam dpal dpa' bo yis// bstan pa rgyas dang de 'dzin tshogs rnams kyi// sku tshe phrin las skye dgu'i bde skyid la// bar du gcod pa thams cad zlog tu gsol/ khyad par rig 'dzin bdag cag dpon slob dang*// yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa'i// sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung dgra bgegs gdon// nad rims dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zlog tu gsol// phyi nang drang srong dmod pa byad mthu dang*// byur dang skal ngan mi shis dus min 'chi// keg sri langs sogs chag che nyam nga ba'i// 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zlog tu gsol// phrin las chad lhag dam rdzas ma tshang nyams// bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing dus kyi mchod pa chag /ting 'dzin ma gsal gsang sngags sgra nyams sogs// sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus bshags par bgyi// tshe dpal stobs 'byor dbang phyug phun sum tshogs// lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan sogs// 'khor 'das dngos grub kun dang khyad par du// 'jam mgon kun bzang tshe 'dir mngon gyur shog / ces 'dod gsol smon lam bya'o/// /
